description.en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值：**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **20**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值。
description.en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
*   If a value is returned for NextToken, specify the value in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

description.zh:
转发路由器实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region to which the transit router belongs.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息。
description.en:
The tags.

You can specify up to 20 tags in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-multicast-domains --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --cen-id cen-a7syd349kne38g0000 --transit-router-id tr-p0wr9p28r92d598y60000 --transit-router-multicast-domain-id tr-mcast-domain-3r3bvbypxqheej0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --tag Value=TagValue Key=TagKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TagKey --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --TransitRouterMulticastDomainId 'tr-mcast-domain-3r3bvbypxqheej0000' --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value TagValue --CenId 'cen-a7syd349kne38g0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --TransitRouterId 'tr-p0wr9p28r92d598y60000'
